issuer_name.description: Government agency or lender issuing the statement, e.g. Inland Revenue.

borrower_name.description: Name of the borrower in the mailing address block.

borrower_tax_id.description: Borrower's tax or customer identifier printed in the header (IRD number on a New Zealand statement), as printed.

reference_number.description: Statement reference number printed in the header.

issue_date.description: Date the statement was issued, as YYYY-MM-DD.

balance_as_at_date.description: Date the current loan balance is stated as at, as YYYY-MM-DD.

current_loan_balance.description: Current student loan balance, in dollars.

increases.description: Rows of the 'Increases to your loan' table, excluding the total row.

description.description: Row label, e.g. Compulsory course fees.

amount.description: Amount added to the loan, in dollars, as a positive number.

total_increases.description: Bold total printed directly below the rows of the 'Increases to your loan' table, in dollars (a positive number).

decreases.description: Rows of the 'Decreases to your loan' table, excluding the total row.

description.description: Row label, e.g. Salary and wage deductions.

amount.description: Amount as printed, in dollars; decreases are printed negative, so keep the sign.

total_decreases.description: Bold total printed directly below the rows of the 'Decreases to your loan' table, in dollars. It is printed negative; keep the sign. Not the increases total.

previous_statement_date.description: Date the previous statement was issued, from the recent loan details section, as YYYY-MM-DD.

previous_statement_balance.description: Loan balance on the previous statement, in dollars.

recent_transactions.description: Rows of the recent loan details tables (new or changed amounts since the last statement).

interest_rate_percent.description: Current annual interest rate for loans that are not interest free, in percent.

late_payment_interest_rate_percent.description: Current annual late payment interest rate, in percent (the standard rate, not the reduced instalment rate).
